Definition: from G2788; to play on a lyre:--harp.
BiblicalUsage: Kitharizo means to play on the lyre, to harp. 1 Corinthians 14:7 uses the harp to teach about clear speech in the church, and Revelation 14:2 hears the voice of harpers harping with their harps in heaven.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the harp's two uses belong together: a harp that gives no distinction in its sounds is no use in church, and the harps of heaven give a sound no one mistakes.
